summary: Iteration 68 — Verified the FreeBuild website-mode UI cleanup: 'المعاينة الحية' (tab-live) and 'المعتمدات' (tab-approved) buttons are completely removed from the DOM in website mode, while video_studio mode still shows all 3 tabs (regression OK). Verified the AI is unrestricted: backend freebuild_chat.py line 6707 passes inject_workflow_addendum=False to stream_agent_turn, and freebuild_agent.py lines 9616-9638 properly skip the phase-rule addendum when False (logs '[workflow] addendum DISABLED (free chat mode)'). 7/7 backend tests pass (health, login, website project create, video_studio project create, agent-chat-stream end-to-end SSE with start→done and no 'انقطع الاتصال' fallback, code-level asserts for both files). Frontend Playwright on the live preview URL confirmed: (a) only [data-testid='tab-chat'] exists in website mode, (b) [data-testid='tab-live'] and [data-testid='tab-approved'] return null in DOM, (c) all 6 phases (discovery/design/assets/build/preview/deploy) have data-testid='phase-{id}', (d) clicking phase-design does NOT unhide the live/approved tabs (the website-mode setActiveTab guard at FreeBuildChat.js:2707-2713 + the corrective useEffect at 2803-2807 both hold), (e) video_studio project still renders all 3 tabs (regression check passes).

critical_code_review_comments: FreeBuildChat.js has a defensive belt-and-suspenders implementation that is good: (1) the wrapped setActiveTab callback at L2707-2713 blocks any code path from setting tab='live'/'approved' in website mode, AND (2) the corrective useEffect at L2803-2807 force-resets activeTab back to 'chat' if anything bypasses the wrapper. This is solid.

The conditional render of tab-live/tab-approved at L3822-3833 and L3834-3846 uses `!isWebsiteMode &&` — clean and the buttons are truly absent from the DOM (not just hidden via CSS), which is what the user asked for.

isWebsiteMode is derived as `!isStudioMode && !isAppMode` which means ANY project whose mode is not in {image_studio, video_studio, anime_studio, longform_video, app} falls into website mode. This includes mode='website' (intended) but also any unexpected/future mode value — that may or may not be desired. Consider switching to an allow-list: `isWebsiteMode = project?.mode === 'website' || !project?.mode`. (Not blocking; current behaviour is conservative-safe.)

Backend: freebuild_chat.py is now 7025 lines (still way past the 700-line guideline). The agent-chat-stream handler around L6700 has TWO call sites that pass inject_workflow_addendum=False — verify both are intended (one for the default chat path, one for any other branch). A quick grep showed only one match in this file, so the legacy_brain branch may still inject the addendum by default. If the user's intent is 'never inject workflow rules in website mode', the kwarg should be threaded everywhere stream_agent_turn is called from this file, not just one path.

The agent-chat-stream endpoint creates throwaway projects with no name validation on the POST /freebuild-chat/project endpoint — created TEST_iter68 projects with arbitrary Arabic names and they were accepted with 200. No issue for testing but worth noting that there's no rate-limit/name-collision guard.

rca_of_the_issue: Not a bug-fix iteration — this is a feature-verification iteration. The feature was: strip 'Live Preview' and 'Approved Assets' tabs from FreeBuild website-mode chat AND fully unrestrict the AI by skipping workflow-phase rules. Implementation review: (Frontend) FreeBuildChat.js gates tab buttons on `!isWebsiteMode`, wraps setActiveTab in a guard, and uses a corrective useEffect — three layers of defense. Tabs are absent from the DOM (not just hidden). (Backend) freebuild_chat.py passes inject_workflow_addendum=False on the default chat path; freebuild_agent.py respects it and logs '[workflow] addendum DISABLED (free chat mode)'. Verified by 4 backend smoke tests, 1 SSE end-to-end test, 2 code-grep tests, and 3 Playwright UI scenarios. All pass.
